auth.title: Sign in
auth.description: Continue with Google or GitHub to generate meal recommendations.
auth.configurationError: Clerk sign-in is not configured yet. Configure the Clerk environment variables, then restart the development server.

home.title: What to eat today
home.stepFridge: Check what is in the fridge

recommend.title: Generate a meal recommendation
recommend.description: Generate one to five dish candidates from the ingredients already in your fridge. Temporary requirements and consumption suggestions are not saved to history.
recommend.temporaryRequirementPlaceholder: For example: keep dinner light and finish within 20 minutes
recommend.temporaryNote: The temporary requirement affects this generation only. After choosing a dish, edit and confirm its ingredient consumption.
recommend.noConsumption: This dish has no fridge consumption suggestions to confirm.
recommend.confirmConsumptionDescription: Deduct the suggested ingredients for {name} from your fridge? Review the quantities before continuing.
recommend.confirmationTip: Tip: confirming will deduct the selected ingredients from your fridge. Items with quantity 0 are deleted automatically.

imageStatus.failed: Image generation failed. The text recommendation is still available.

openAiKey.title: OpenAI API key
openAiKey.description: Only user-owned OpenAI developer API keys are supported. ChatGPT Plus, Pro, or other consumer subscriptions are not supported.
openAiKey.deleteDescription: Delete the currently saved OpenAI API key? This cannot be undone.
openAiKey.imageVerificationNote: gpt-image-2 may require your OpenAI organization to complete verification before image generation is available.

preferences.title: Food preferences
preferences.description: Describe long-term food preferences in natural language. They guide future recommendations without being copied into history snapshots.
preferences.placeholder: For example: avoid cilantro, prefer light home-style meals, and keep weekday cooking under 30 minutes.

history.title: Recommendation history
history.empty: No recommendation history yet. Generated dish text and image status will appear here.
history.deleteRecommendationDescription: Delete the recommendation generated at {name} and its dish images. This cannot be undone.
history.deleteDishDescription: Delete {name} and its dish image from history. This cannot be undone.

fridge.title: My fridge
fridge.description: Manage ingredient inventory with natural-language names and free-text units. Matching names and units automatically merge quantities.
fridge.name: Ingredient name
fridge.deleteDescription: Delete {name} from your fridge. This cannot be undone.
fridge.mergeNote: For example: 2 tomatoes or 1 bunch of water spinach. Quantity or unit changes keep the image; name changes regenerate it.
fridge.empty: Your fridge is empty. Add a few ingredients before generating recommendations.

imageStatus.failed: Image generation failed. Retry is available.

errors.missingOpenAiKey: Configure an OpenAI API key first.
errors.invalidOpenAiKey: The OpenAI API key is invalid.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again later.
errors.fridgeEmpty: Your fridge is empty. Add ingredients first.
errors.fridgeItemNotFound: The ingredient could not be found.
errors.recommendationNotFound: The recommendation history record could not be found.
errors.fridgeConflict: Your fridge inventory changed. Refresh and confirm consumption again.
errors.dishNotFound: The historical dish could not be found.
errors.modelResponseInvalid: The model response format is invalid. Try again.
errors.upstreamOpenAiError: The OpenAI request failed. Try again later.
errors.localCodexUnavailable: Local Codex cannot complete this generation task right now.
errors.configurationError: The server is missing required configuration.
errors.notImplemented: This feature is not connected to the real service yet.
